Snail1KO: RNA-seq counts from Snai1 knock-out HS578T cells

Source: R/SnailKO.R
Snail1KO.Rd

Raw RNA-seq read counts and sample metadata for human HS578T triple-negative breast carcinoma cells: 3 wild-type and 3 Snai1 knock-out samples, from Maturi et al. (2018), ArrayExpress E-MTAB-5244 (ENA ERP019920).

Usage

data(Snail1KO)

Format

A list with two elements:

rawCounts

A data.frame of raw (unnormalized) integer read counts with 39,364 genes (rows) x 6 samples (columns). Row names are gene symbols (the Expression Atlas "Gene Name" for each Ensembl gene ID). Column names are ENA run accessions (ERR1736465 to ERR1736470).

metadata

A data.frame with 6 rows (samples, with run accessions as row names) and 4 columns: Sample (run accession), Disease ("breast carcinoma"), Genotype ("WT" or "Snai1_KO") and CellLine_CellType ("HS578T - epithelial cell").

Source

Counts: EMBL-EBI Expression Atlas, experiment E-MTAB-5244 (https://www.ebi.ac.uk/gxa/experiments/E-MTAB-5244), raw-count file downloaded 2026-11-22. Raw data: ArrayExpress E-MTAB-5244 / ENA ERP019920.

Details

  • Organism: Homo sapiens, HS578T cell line.

  • Gene IDs: gene symbols. The source counts are per Ensembl gene ID (GRCh38, Ensembl release 107). Each Ensembl ID was replaced with its gene symbol, and for each symbol only the first gene in Ensembl ID order was kept. This removed 1,194 duplicated symbols and 21,302 genes with no symbol. One symbol-less gene (ENSG00000083622, zero counts) remains, with an empty row name "".

  • Quantification: by Expression Atlas with iRAP 1.0.3 (TopHat2 2.1.1 alignment, HTSeq 0.11.0 counting).

  • No other filtering or normalization was done.

The script that builds this object from the Expression Atlas download is in the installed package: system.file("scripts", "make-Snail1KO.R", package = "RGenEDA").

License

Expression Atlas data are released under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International licence (CC BY 4.0; https://www.ebi.ac.uk/gxa/licence.html). Please cite Maturi et al. (2018) and Expression Atlas when you use these data.

Examples

data(Snail1KO)
dim(Snail1KO$rawCounts)
#> [1] 39364     6
Snail1KO$metadata
#>                Sample          Disease Genotype        CellLine_CellType
#> ERR1736465 ERR1736465 breast carcinoma       WT HS578T - epithelial cell
#> ERR1736466 ERR1736466 breast carcinoma       WT HS578T - epithelial cell
#> ERR1736467 ERR1736467 breast carcinoma       WT HS578T - epithelial cell
#> ERR1736468 ERR1736468 breast carcinoma Snai1_KO HS578T - epithelial cell
#> ERR1736469 ERR1736469 breast carcinoma Snai1_KO HS578T - epithelial cell
#> ERR1736470 ERR1736470 breast carcinoma Snai1_KO HS578T - epithelial cell
